headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Documentation audit across 9 Blockstream properties crawled 28,886 pages (4.02% of 766,787 discovered URLs). 1,222 broken links exist in user-facing docs (190 additional broken repo navigation links). API reference coverage is 14.57% across 984 detected API pages. Retrieval readiness scores 64.89/100 (moderate band) with only 53.3% answerability and 62.53% stale-risk flagged pages. Only 37.74% of pages display last-updated metadata, and 27.8% have SEO/geo issues.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

priority_actions.title: Fix 1,222 broken internal documentation links across user-facing sites
priority_actions.why_this_first: Broken links directly block user journeys and signal neglect, damaging trust and increasing support volume immediately.

priority_actions.title: Add last-updated timestamps to the 62.47% of pages missing freshness metadata (18,000+ pages)
priority_actions.why_this_first: Low-effort metadata addition immediately reduces stale-risk perception, boosts user confidence, and improves AI answer quality with recency signals.

priority_actions.title: Increase API reference coverage from 14.57% to at least 60% by documenting missing endpoints across 984 detected API pages
priority_actions.why_this_first: Developer onboarding and integration success depend on complete API docs; 85% gap is a primary blocker to adoption and self-service.

strengths: Example code reliability estimated at 98.31%, indicating high quality of working samples
Actionability coverage at 98.67% shows docs provide clear next steps
Citationability at 99.95% enables accurate source attribution for AI and support
risks: 682,657 links unverified due to auth/rate-limit blocks; true broken link count may be significantly higher than reported 1,222
Crawl reached only 4.02% of discovered scope (28,886 of 766,787 pages); large documentation surface remains unaudited
Overall audit confidence at 49.1% and link confidence at 25% limit reliability of findings
API coverage at 14.57% leaves 85% of API surface undocumented or undetected, blocking developer onboarding
limitations: Crawl reached only 4.02% of discovered scope; findings may not represent quality across 738,000+ uncrawled pages, especially behind authentication or dynamic navigation.
682,657 links could not be verified due to auth, rate limits, or server blocks; actual broken link count may be substantially higher than the 1,412 confirmed.
Overall confidence at 49.1% and link confidence at 25% indicate significant detection gaps; manual validation required for business-critical decisions.
automation_first: Deploy automated broken link checker across all 9 properties to catch the 1,222 confirmed broken docs links (plus 190 repo links) on every commit, preventing future link rot and reducing manual QA burden by 80%.

Implement CI-based freshness enforcement requiring last-updated metadata on publish, targeting the 62.47% of pages (18,000+) currently missing timestamps, to eliminate stale-risk flags and improve retrieval ranking with zero ongoing manual effort.

Add pre-commit API reference coverage gate to flag undocumented endpoints, addressing the 85% API documentation gap (984 pages detected, 14.57% covered) and ensuring new endpoints ship with docs, preventing coverage regression and reducing post-release documentation debt by 70%.
